# FG-DEPLOY-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 502 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`deploy`](../../ops/runbooks/deploy.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_failed_rollback_is_rollback_failed` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: デプロイの失敗の後のロールバックが失敗しました。環境が壊れたままの可能性があります。管理者に問い合わせ番号を伝えてください。
- en: The rollback after a failed deployment failed. The environment may still be broken. Give the request ID to the administrator.
- id: Rollback setelah deployment yang gagal juga gagal. Lingkungan mungkin masih rusak. Berikan ID permintaan kepada administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C11 (ADR-0031 decision 8): a deployment failed on an environment with `auto_rollback`, and `<script> rollback <previous_sha>` or the health check after it failed on a target, or there was no previous version to go back to (the environment's first deployment). The environment is in an unknown state.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The worker logs `forge.deploy.rollback_failed` (error) with `error_code`, `request_id`, `deployment_id`, `target`, `previous_sha` and `reason` (`no_previous_version` / `script_failed` / `health_failed` / `unreachable` / `host_key_mismatch`). Read: SELECT id, status, sha, previous_sha, error_code, failed_target FROM forge.deployments WHERE id = <deployment_id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook deploy (Rollback failed): restore the target by hand from its own release directory, then deploy a known good SHA.
